Leaving combat will reset the counter.
source_abilities.Passive: Double Jump to leap into the air.

yin.pick_when: Pick a confident projectile-timing player into attacks her defensive tools can actually answer.
yin.counterplay: Bait Backlash or wait out the projectile-control window, then commit from another angle. Do not assume a projectile answer also stops every ground area or non-projectile control effect.

source_abilities.RMB:
Yin cracks her whip, Pushing away nearby Enemies. Deals 20/40/60/80/100 (+100% physical power)(+60% magical power) physical damage and creates a sphere of pressure around her for 0.8s.
If Enemy projectiles hit the sphere, they are reflected toward the target location.
source_abilities.E:
Passive: Every third successful consecutive basic attack will deal 2/2.5/3/3.5/4% of the target’s maximum health as bonus physical damage and heals Yin for +(10/12/14/16/18% physical power) Health.
Active: Yin extends her whip, increasing the range of her basic attack to 1100 units 
and gaining 30/40/50/60/70% cleave for 6s.
source_abilities.R:
Yin surrounds herself in gale winds.
For 5s, the winds will apply a 10% Slow to Enemies within and grants Yin 10% movement speed. 
Enemy projectiles that travel through it are halted.

yurei.pick_when: Pick marked-target mobility and attack weaving after an ally creates the opening.
yurei.counterplay: Avoid leaving a chain of marked reachable targets. Punish Severance without its reset condition and keep control for the ultimate wind-up rather than following her through every reset.

source_abilities.RMB: Launch three projectiles that explode, each dealing 30/40/50/60/70 (+35% physical power) damage to targets hit and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
source_abilities.Q:
Perform a spinning kick that deals 70/90/110/130/150 (+70% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and apply Soul Rip to them for 4s.
If cast in-air, you will additionaly leap upwards in your current movement direction.
Heal 20/35/50/65/80 (+75% physical power) health, increased by 0-50% based on missing health if an Enemy Hero or Monster is hit.
source_abilities.E:
Rush forwards, dealing 55/75/95/115/135 (+115% physical power) physical damage to targets hit.
Colliding with a target affected by Soul Rip consumes it to reset the cooldown of Severance and tear their Soul from the target for 4s. Souls linger around their hosts with 8% of their maximum health and share any damage dealt to them with their host.
Consuming Soul Rip with a Soul still active will refresh its health.
source_abilities.R:
Channel for 1.5s, dealing 75/125/175 (+50% physical power) physical damage to nearby enemies and applying Soul Rip to them.
At the end of the duration, pull all targets towards you, tear their spirits and strike downwards, dealing 130/215/300 (+80% physical power) physical damage and reset the cooldown of Severence.

zarus.pick_when: Pick jungle containment with mid/support conversion and a disciplined exit plan.
zarus.counterplay: Keep an escape or peel response for Coliseum and attack the unsupported entry. The arena limits movement but does not silence or stun everyone inside; continue using valid defensive tools.

source_abilities.Q:
Unfold a shield for 1.5s, reducing incoming damage by 75%.
Upon recasting or after the duration, swing the shield dealing 54/70/86/102/118 (+90% physical power) physical damage increased up to 135/175/215/255/295 (+225% physical power) and Stunning targets hit for 0.75s.
source_abilities.E:
Dash in your current movement direction, gaining 20% movement speed for 1s and 12/16/20/24/28% (+20% magical power) Attack Speed for 3.5s.
If cast in-air, you will additionally dash slightly upwards in your current movement direction.
source_abilities.R:
Leap at an Enemy Hero, dealing 200/325/450 (+100% physical power) physical damage. A Coliseum is then summoned for 4s, Zarus gains maximum stacks of Gladiator and its bonus is doubled. 
If the target is killed within the duration, you will permanently gain 5/8/11 Physical Power.

zinx.pick_when: Choose protection for a planned committed fight, with another slot supplying initiation.
zinx.counterplay: Bait Neural Regenesis before the decisive focus, or change targets during protection. Spread from the bouncing control and track the actual Infuse recipient instead of assuming every build heals allies equally.

source_abilities.RMB: Fire a healing bolt at an Ally that restores 60/95/130/165/200 (+50% magical power) Health, increasing by up to 40% based on their missing health.
source_abilities.Q:
Throw an electromagnetic disk dealing 65/90/115/140/165 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Stunning for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The disk can ricochet up to 5 times, dealing its damage again and Stunning each target for 50% of the original duration. 
Will not ricochet to previously hit targets.
source_abilities.E:
Shoot the ground to form a pool of radiation that deals 45/65/85/105/125 (+40% magical power) magical damage and Slows by 35% for 0.75s.
After 0.75s, the radiation erupts dealing 55/85/115/145/175 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Slowing Enemies hit by 35% for 0.75s.
source_abilities.R:
Apply cellular restructuring to Yourself or an Ally Hero, granting 45% decaying Movement Speed and Revival for 4s.
If the Target takes lethal damage within this time, they Resurrect with 500/900/1300 (+235% magical power) Health and 250/400/550 (+110% magical power) Mana after 2.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Hold Shield Bash or Shield Slam for the reappearance/landing rather than spending both on the first tank.
counter_picks.limit: The selected Crushing Descent adds a brief interrupt; do not assume she cannot interrupt your response.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

serath.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
serath.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s
serath.Passive:
Takedowns on Enemy Heroes leave behind a demonic visage for 10s.
Upon touching it, Serath activates Heresy at no cost and reduces her current basic ability cooldowns by 65%.

counter_picks.reason: Use Gag Grenade to deny a response after she becomes targetable, then preserve the airborne blast to separate.
counter_picks.limit: Silence is short and the timing must follow the disappearance; damage still needs a safe firing line.

drongo.Q: Toss a tear gas grenade that explodes dealing 45/65/85/105/125 (+80% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage to Enemy Targets hit and silencing them for 0.8/0.9/1/1.1/1.2s. The gas lasts for 3s, applying Wastelander every 0.3s.
drongo.R:
Unleash a bazooka blast, dealing 170/280/390 (+115% physical power) physical damage to all Enemies hit and Shredding their Physical Armor by 30% for 4s. 
When used In-Air, the blast launches Drongo in the opposite direction, becoming briefly CC Immune and Pushing Back any Enemies in front of him.

serath.Q:
Serath marks a Target and vanishes, striking Enemies at their location 5 times. Each strike deals 40/60/80/100/120 (+20% physical power) physical damage and applies on-hit effects at 35% effectiveness. Additional strikes against the same Target deal 30% damage. Deals 40/50/60/70/80 bonus damage to Monsters.
On her final strike, Serath will teleport to the marked Target's location based on her current position.
If the marked Target dies, Serath teleports immediately.
serath.E:
Serath rises up into the air and hovers for up to 1.8s. During this time, she can target an area up to 1350 units away. Upon confirmation, she dives down and deals 80/100/120/140/160 (+80% physical power)(+50% magical power) physical damage.
Serath automatically dives to the ground after 1.8s
serath.R:
Serath takes demonic form, dealing 60/90/120 (+50% physical power)(+80% magical power) physical damage to nearby Enemies and setting them ablaze.
For the next 7s, she gains 20/25/30% movement speed, 20/40/60% attack speed, and empowers her basic attack with Infernal Strikes. 
Infernal Strikes sets Enemy Units ablaze on-hit, dealing 14/27/40 (+25% physical power)(+20% magical power) true damage on-hit over 2s.

counter_picks.reason: Keep a hook or silence response for the channel rather than opening with every control tool.
counter_picks.limit: A live Truesilver shield prevents control; break or wait out that protection before relying on the interrupt.

riktor.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.
riktor.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.
riktor.R:
Unleash a torrent of chains from Riktor, dealing 110/200/290 (+45% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Suppressing them for 1.3s. 
After the Supression expires Riktor rips the chains out, repeating the damage.

gideon.E:
Leap through a portal in spacetime, appearing at the target location, gaining (+50/75/100/125/150 mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s. The portal remains open for 5s.
Allied Heroes can jump through the portal while it's active.
Portal Distance: 800/875/950/1025/1100u.
gideon.R:
Unleash a black hole beneath Gideon for 3.5s that slowly drags nearby Enemies towards its center, dealing 520/780/1040 (+250% magical power) magical damage. After channelling for 2.75s, Gideon may act and the Black Hole cannot be cancelled.
For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.

counter_picks.reason: Reserve a reachable stun for Black Hole and avoid arriving alongside every allied damage hero.
counter_picks.limit: Range and a shield that grants control immunity can prevent the intended interrupt.

steel.RMB:
Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

gideon.E:
Leap through a portal in spacetime, appearing at the target location, gaining (+50/75/100/125/150 mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s. The portal remains open for 5s.
Allied Heroes can jump through the portal while it's active.
Portal Distance: 800/875/950/1025/1100u.

For each Enemy Hero hit by Black Hole, Gideon gains (+2% mana) increased Maximum Mana for 8s.

counter_picks.reason: Use an alternate angle to force Sparrow away from her protected firing line before she spends the full barrage.
counter_picks.limit: Her support may stop the entry; preserve an exit and do not count delayed Cryoseism as an immediate stun.

aurora.Q:
Aurora dashes forward, leaving behind a wall of ice that other Heroes can walk on for the next 5s. Reactivating the ability will destroy the wall early.
Aurora can stop her movement mid-way by using Hoarfrost or Cryoseism, or by Jumping. 
Additionally, Aurora and her Allies gain 25/30/35/40/45% Movement Speed while walking on the ice.
aurora.E:
Aurora creates a ring of frost on the ground around her. Enemies that touch the ring take 70/110/150/190/230 (+50% magical power) magical damage and are Rooted for 1/1.05/1.1/1.15/1.2s.
The ring remains in the world for 2.5s.
aurora.R:
Aurora freezes an area, applying a 50% Slow to all Enemies for 1.5s. After 1.5s, the ice freezes, Stunning the target for 1s. After the Stun, the Target explodes dealing 200/300/400 (+70% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies.
Enemies damaged by Cryoseism will be Slowed by 50% for 0.5s before exploding, dealing 60/90/120 (+20% magical power) magical damage to them and nearby Enemies. Targets can only be slowed this way once per Cryoseism.

sparrow.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
sparrow.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the rock from an unseen angle and commit the leap only when allies can convert.
counter_picks.limit: A missed boulder or protected carry turns the tank into free attack uptime.

rampage.Q:
Rip a boulder from the earth and carry it for up to 5s. Rampage can throw the boulder, dealing 100/135/170/205/240 (+60% physical power)(+80% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Stunning them for 1.2/1.25/1.3/1.35/1.4s. Shatters on contact with Enemy Heroes.
Behemoth: Throw the boulder instantly.
rampage.RMB:
Leap forward before slamming down to the ground, dealing 80/110/140/170/200 (+5% health) physical damage to nearby Enemies and launching damaged Heroes backwards. The leap can be cancelled early by basic attacking.
Using Pounce while Boulder Throw is active causes it to shatter upon landing, dealing its effects in the area.
Behemoth: Range increases by 65%.

sparrow.E:
Sparrow vanishes from the battlefield, entering Stealth and gaining 30 (+15% magical power) Movement Speed for 1.5s. Upon, reappearing, she gains 25/30/35/40/45% Attack Speed for 6s.
Every second subsequent basics attack against the same target while Heightened Senses is active deals (+15% physical power) bonus physical damage and applies an additional stack of Relentless.
sparrow.R:
Unleash a barrage of fanned arrows, firing 12/14/16 volleys over 3.5s. 
The center arrow deals (+75% physical power)(+40% magical power) physical damage. Side arrows deal (+58% physical power)(+30% magical power) damage instead.
Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the exposed enchanter with a confirmed hook so she must spend protection defensively.
counter_picks.limit: A missed hook is not pressure; allies must reach the catch before she or the carry can reverse it.

riktor.RMB: Launch Riktor's chain forward, attaching to the first Enemy hit, dealing 10/50/90/130/170 (+100% magical power) (+10% of the Target's Max Health) magical damage and Pulling them towards him.
riktor.Q: Swing an electrified whip that destroys enemy shields before dealing 80/115/150/185/220 (+70% physical power)(+60% magical power) magical damage and Silencing them for 0.8s.

muriel.Q:
Sanctify the ground with an angelic light for 6s. 
Allies within the area gain 10/12.5/15/17.5/20% Total Attack Speed and restore 60/80/100/120/140 (+20% magical power) Health over its lifetime.
Enemies within the area have their Total Attack Speed reduced by 10/11.5/13/14.5/16% and receive 90/120/150/180/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage over its lifetime.
muriel.E:
Throw an orb that applies a 80/120/160/200/240 (+60% magical power) shield to the first Allied Hero it touches, granting them 15/17.5/20/22.5/25% Decaying Movement Speed for 4s.
Remains in the world for 8s if untouched.
muriel.R:
Prepare for flight, allowing Muriel to target an Allied Hero anywhere in the world, granting them 35% Damage Reduction and a 280/480/680 (+100% magical power) Shield for 2.5s as you soar to their location.
On arrival, nearby Enemies take 100/160/220 (+40% magical power) magical damage and are Knocked Up for 0.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Keep silence for the channel and use a compatible anti-heal purchase if grouped restoration is the problem.
counter_picks.limit: Silence alone is not sustained anti-heal, and the support can continue protecting after it ends.

drongo.Q: Toss a tear gas grenade that explodes dealing 45/65/85/105/125 (+80% physical power)(+120% magical power) physical damage to Enemy Targets hit and silencing them for 0.8/0.9/1/1.1/1.2s. The gas lasts for 3s, applying Wastelander every 0.3s.
drongo.E:
Irradiate Drongo's basic attacks, granting him 20/22.5/25/27.5/30% Attack Speed for 4s. During this window, shots Irradiate Enemies for 1.5s, the timer refreshing with each hit. 
After Irradiate expires, the target erupts, dealing 8/15/22/29/36 (+22% physical power) physical damage to them for the first stack, and 8/15/22/29/36 (+22% physical power) for subsequent stacks. Applies an additional stack of Wastelander per Irradiate stack.
If Drongo damages irradiated targets with Old Rusty or Shrapnel Cannon, they erupt immediately.
The cooldown begins on activation.

narbash.E:
Toggle: Play a soothing beat, granting Narbash and his Allies additional Speed or Healing.
Healing Aura: Grants 1.5/2.5/3.5/4.5/5.5 (+2% magical power) Health Regeneration.
Speed Aura: Grants 4.5/5.5/6.5/7.5/8.5% (+3% [HasteIconWhite]) Movement Speed.
narbash.R:
Narbash Slows himself by 30% and Channels a drum solo for 3s. Nearby Enemies receive 5/7.5/10 (+4% magical power)(+7% physical power) magical damage per hit and are Slowed by 5%, stacking up to 5 times. 
Enemies afflicted with maximum Slow stacks become Mesmerized instead.
The final hit deals 80/150/220 (+80% magical power)(+120% physical power) magical damage, Knocking Up all Enemies and Stunning them for 0.5s.

counter_picks.reason: Use the stun and fence to break access after Ambush rather than fight his full sustained-contact window.
counter_picks.limit: An available movement spell or allied follow-up can still reconnect; watch the actual route.

dekker.RMB:
Launch a bouncing bomb, dealing 70/95/120/145/170 (+45% magical power) magical damage and Stunning Enemies hit in a small area for 0.9s. 
Stun duration increases up to 1.6s based on distance (3500 units max).
dekker.E: Deploy a circular energy fence for 2.6/2.75/2.9/3.05/3.2s, preventing Enemy Heroes from passing through.

khaimera.RMB:
Leap to an Enemy Hero or Monster, dealing 75/105/135/165/195 (+70% physical power) physical damage and Slowing them by 25/30/35/40/45% for 1.35s. Deals up to 2x damage based on the Target's missing health. 
Grants 15 Rage on hit.
khaimera.Q:
Unleash Khaimera's primal spirit for 3s, granting him maximum attack speed for 5 successful attacks.
Khaimera gains an additional attack for every 30 Magical Power owned. 
Each basic attack deals (+54/58/62/66/70% physical power)(+12% magical power) physical damage, applies on-hit effects at 65% effectiveness and Cleaves nearby Enemies for 75% damage.
khaimera.E:
Khaimera instantly Cleanses all Debuffs and Heals himself for 5/7/9/11/13% of his maximum health (+4x current health regeneration).
Cleansing grants Crowd Control Immunity for 0.25s.

counter_picks.reason: Hold Seismic Assault for the committed Feast or pressure the marked return point with allies.
counter_picks.limit: A protection effect or missed line can deny the response; this is not proof of a winning lane matchup.

lt-belica.Q:
Slam the ground, sending forth a seismic wave that erupts after 0.5s, dealing 100/145/190/235/280 (+60% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in its path, Knocking Up and Stunning them for 1s. 
Innovation: Stun duration increases to 1.4s.
The hitbox width is 270u. This ability can be Blink-proxied during the cast.
lt-belica.E:
Deploy a drone for 12s that grants vision in the area and drains 2/2.75/3.5/4.25/5% of nearby Enemy Heroes' Current Mana each second. 
The drone zaps nearby Heroes if they cast an ability, or if Lt. Belica damages them with an ability, dealing 60/70/80/90/100 (+20% magical power) magical damage and draining 2.5% of the Target's Maximum Mana. 
Innovation: Zap Max Mana drain increases to 6%.

countess.Q:
Rapidly dash to a location in a cloud of blood, dealing 40/60/80/100/120 (+35% magical power) magical damage to nearby enemies and slowing them by 25% for 1.25s.
A Shadow is left in your original position. Re-triggering the ability within 3.5s will swap places with the Shadow.
countess.R:
Leap to an Enemy Hero, forcing them to face Countess and Suppress them for 0.75s.
After the duration, Countess deals 135/215/285 (+5% (+2.5% magical power) of the target's maximum health) magical damage and applying Haemorrhage.
Targets already affected by Haemorrhage take 50% bonus damage and Countess restores health equal to 100% of the damage dealt.

counter_picks.reason: Attack the reachable frontline from protected range and switch pressure while his personal survival extends.
counter_picks.limit: Without peel, the ranged advantage disappears; do not spend every cooldown on the extra-life window.

Inner Fire's arrows pierce Enemy Units, can Critically Strike and apply On-Hit effects at 30% effectiveness.

greystone.R:
Greystone enters Stasis for 2.5s, restoring 14/16/18% (+2.5% magical power) of his maximum health (increased by up to 2.5x based on missing health) and Slowing nearby Enemies by up to 70%, based on proximity.
After 2.5s, crash down, dealing 250/400/550 (+180% physical power)(+100% magical power) physical damage to all Enemies in the area.
greystone.Passive:
Deflect the next incoming basic attack every 15/14.4/13.8/13.2/12.6/12/11.4/10.8/10.2/9.6/9/8.4/7.8/7.2/6.6/6/5.4/4.8s.
Additionally, Greystone regenerates (+0.1% health) health per second and gains 4 (+0.5 per level) Physical Armor. 
These values are increased by 1% per 1% missing health, and the regeneration is doubled while below 50% max health.

counter_picks.reason: Force the linked pair to split their attention with a catch angle and vision denial.
counter_picks.limit: A saved pull can undo an unsupported catch; wait for the second opening rather than chasing both targets.

mourn.RMB:
Channel for up to 3s, Slowing yourself by 25% and wind up your vines, increasing their range over 1s. After 3s the ability will be cancelled and go on a 50% cooldown.
Confirm to unleash the vines that will collide with the first enemy target hit dealing 80/125/170/215/260 (+85% magical power) magical damage, Pulling them towards Mourn and Slowing them by 90% for 0.75s.
mourn.E:
Mourn channels energy into his fist for up to 2.1s, expanding up to 800u over 1.5s. While channeling, Mourn gains 20% Damage Reduction and Slows himself by 30%.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Enemies within take 80/110/140/170/200 (+45% magical power) magical damage and are Mesmerized for 0.45-1.2s (based on 0-1.5s channel duration).
mourn.R:
Mourn absorbs light from the map for 4s, causing all Enemy Heroes to have massively reduced vision.
Additionally, Mourn applies Contagion to all Heroes in the world and gains 40/60/80% Movement Speed for the duration.

phase.RMB:
Create a Link between yourself and an Ally, granting both Heroes 3/4/5/6/7% increased Physical Power and Magical Power. If reactivated, Phase will Pull the Linked Ally towards her.
The Link will turn Pink if any Ally wanders too far out of range and will break if they do not return within 1s.
Allies that are Immobilized cannot be Pulled.
Maximum link radius is 1700u. If the linked ally is 2100u away, the link breaks immediately, regardless of the one-second grace window.
phase.R: Phase overcharges herself and her Linked Ally, granting both 40/60/80% attack speed, 40/60/80 ability haste and 135% decaying movement speed for 8s.

counter_picks.reason: Keep control beside the threatened carry and deny the exposed finishing route after Kallari reveals.
counter_picks.limit: Force Shield is a projectile answer, not a universal defense against melee attacks.

Swipe forward with Steel's shield, dealing 35/65/95/125/155 (+50% magical power) (+5/5.75/6.5/7.25/8% of the Target's maximum health) magical damage to all Enemies in front of him and Stunning them for 0.5s.
Deals 50/55/60/65/70 additional damage to Monsters.
steel.E:
Deploy a disruptive wall of energy, blocking all incoming Enemy Projectiles for 4s.
When an Enemy Hero first passes through the wall, they take 50/75/100/125/150 (+30% magical power) magical damage and are Slowed by 25/30/35/40/45% for 0.75s.
steel.R: Leap into the sky, crashing down at the target location to deal 200/320/440 (+90% magical power) magical damage to all Enemies in the area, Knocking them Up and Stunning them for 1.5s.

kallari.Q:
After 1.5s, enter Camouflage, gaining 40% decaying movement speed for 6s. While in this state, nearby Enemy Heroes and Wards reveal Kallari.
Attacking ends Camouflage instantly.
Passive: Gain 2 (+75% physical penetration) Health Regeneration when Out of Vision.
kallari.R:
After a brief delay Kallari dashes forward, cutting through all Enemies in her path, dealing 120/250/380 (+65/75/85% physical power) physical damage. 
Deals up to 2.5x damage based on the Target's missing health.

counter_picks.reason: Use ranged zone pressure to contest the prepared space before the team commits inside the turret nest.
counter_picks.limit: This is a composition-space answer, not a verified mid-versus-offlane duel; frontline still comes from another pick.

gadget.Q:
Launch a sticky mine that attaches to any Enemy Hero in its path, or any nearby Unit upon landing. 
After 2.5s, the mine explodes, dealing 90/120/150/180/210 (+70% magical power) magical damage.
Landing a Basic Attack against an Enemy with an attached Sticky Mine empowers it, dealing 110/150/190/230/270 (+95% magical power) magical damage instead.
Sticky Mines that attach to yourself or Allied Units are also empowered.
gadget.R:
Unleash Gadget's Tesla Dome, dealing 480/780/1080 (+220% magical power) magical damage over 5s to all Enemies caught within. 
Each instance of damage shreds the Target's magical armor by 3.5% for 3s and briefly Slows them by 50%.
Tesla Dome grows 60% larger over its initial lifetime.

iggy-scorch.Q:
Iggy throws down a turret with 100 (+24 per Hero Level) (+10-32.5% magical power) Health that shoots homing fireballs at Enemy Targets within 1500 units. Each fireball deals 11/16/21/26/31 (+30% magical power) magical damage.
Iggy can have up to 3 turrets placed. Hitting an enemy with Spew redirects turrets to attack that target if in range. They also gain 40% Attack Speed if the Target is an Enemy Hero, or when Iggy casts Inferno.
Flame Turrets take 70% increased damage from Melee basic attacks.
iggy-scorch.E:
Scorch hurls a ball of oil that rolls in the target direction dealing 70/105/140/175/210 (+50% magical power) magical damage to enemies hit. The oil will then remain for 5s, slowing enemies by 30/35/40/45/50%.
When ignited by Iggy's fire abilities, the duration is refreshed and enemies take 10/15/20/25/30 (+12% magical power) magical damage every 0.5s.
iggy-scorch.R:
Scorch unleashes a cone of flame gaining 20/25/30% Movement Speed and dealing 375/600/825 (+260% magical power) magical damage over 3s.
At the end of the duration, or upon reactivation, Scorch will belch, instantly dealing 120/180/240 (+60% magical power) magical damage in the area and Knocking Back any Enemy Heroes present.

counter_picks.reason: Threaten the short firing window with a direct catch and keep a separate response for the isolated ally's return.
counter_picks.limit: Reckoning can remove your intended focus from allied damage; coordinate which target remains reachable.

revenant.LMB:
Ranged basic attack dealing 53/55.38/57.89/60.52/63.29/66.18/69.19/72.34/75.61/79.01/82.54/86.19/89.98/93.89/97.92/102.09/106.38/110.8 (+85% physical power) physical damage.
The final round will always critically strike.
After four basic attacks, Revenant will automatically reload.
revenant.R:
Revenant pulls himself and his Target into the Nether Realm for 6/7/8s and Slows them by 80% for 0.7s. During this time, he steals 8/9/10% of their Physical & Magical Power.
Killing his opponent inside the Nether Realm grants 2x the bonus gold gained from Bounty Hunter.

counter_picks.reason: Enter from another angle after defensive displacement is spent and force him to move away from his area setup.
counter_picks.limit: Do not chase through the full orbital field or assume your delayed ultimate controls him immediately.

legion.Q:
Legion fires a heavy payload that deploys 10 Cluster Mines upon hitting the world, Enemies or by reactivation. 
Each Cluster Mine deals 35/45/55/65/75 (+50% physical power) (+40% magical power) Physical Damage and Slows Enemies hit by 40% for 1s. 
Consecutive Mine hits on the same Enemy deal 25% Damage.
legion.E:
Legion calls in a standard and becomes Unstoppable for 0.5s, dealing 20/25/30/35/40 (+20% physical power) Physical Damage whilst Knocking Back nearby Enemies. 
The Standard rallies nearby Allies for 8s if they remain within 1500 units. 
Allies gain 8% Movement Speed and heal for 5/8/11/14/17 (+100% physical penetration) (+10% magical power) Health every Second.
Additionally, Enemy Wards are Revealed.
Legion gains Infinite Ammo.
legion.R:
Legion lobs a target designator that deploys upon landing. After a 0.75s delay, an Orbital Beam blasts the designated location, tracking Enemy Targets, prioritising Heroes.
Enemy Targets within the blast take 30/50/70 (+26% physical power) (+10% magical power) Physical Damage every 0.25s. The Orbital Beam persists for 6/7.5/9s.
If there are no Enemy Targets within 2000 units, the blast remains stationary.

build_adaptations.when: Little interrupt pressure and a safe allied entry
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing damage item and delay the bracelet; this reorders the same six, rather than adding a seventh item.

build_adaptations.when: Another reliable initiator exists and you can farm safely
build_adaptations.reason: Trade the early catch-amplification spike for health-stacking clear. Its value needs actual unit kills, so do not choose it only for a late six-item screenshot.

item_effects.name: Colossal Cleave
item_effects.text:
• Deal (+1% health) physical damage.
• Deal (+30% physical power) (+2.5% health) physical damage around the Target.
• Damage decreases from 100% to 50% based on distance.

item_effects.name: Devourer
item_effects.text:
• Permanently gain 1 Health.
• Camp Leaders grant 3.
• Heroes grant 5.
• Upon reaching 100 stacks, gain an additional 125 Health.

build_adaptations.when: Reliable attack access and a need for more basic-ability cycling
build_adaptations.reason: Trade chain-clear pressure for the item’s attack-triggered cooldown support. Respect the listed trigger limits; neither this choice nor a community guide proves an infinite reset loop.

item_effects.name: Chrono Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.
• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.
• Only triggers once per ability.
• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

build_adaptations.when: A reachable healing threat needs an answer before crit scaling
build_adaptations.reason: Buy compatible on-attack anti-heal earlier, then revisit the flexible finish. Do not make the swap when another ally already maintains the required debuff.

item_effects.name: Blighted Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
• Deal (+10% physical power) (+20% [BonusDamage]) magical damage On-Hit.
• Increases by up to 100% as the Target's Health decreases.

build_adaptations.when: The fight rewards repeated Rad Rounds windows more than an execute
build_adaptations.reason: Rad Rounds now starts its cooldown on activation, making basic-attack cooldown support relevant. This is an uptime alternative with a burst tradeoff, not a promise of permanent irradiation.

item_effects.name: Chrono Strikes
item_effects.text:
• Decrease current Non-Ultimate Cooldowns by 8% On-Hit.
• Reduced to 4% against Non-Heroes.
• Only triggers once per ability.
• Critical Strikes grant 1.5x the cooldown reduction.

build_adaptations.when: The protected partner is a burst-oriented Revenant or ability Legion
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing protection-triggered power item instead of valuing raw attack speed as though every carry uses it equally. Preserve the original six only if later allies can use Marshal; otherwise replace the late aura for the actual threats.

item_effects.name: Elation
item_effects.text:
• You both gain 30 Magical Power for 5s.
• You both gain 15 Ability Haste for 5s.

build_adaptations.when: An enemy spell must be answered before a full damage commitment
build_adaptations.reason: Advance the existing spell shield only when it can absorb the relevant opener. Bait spells can remove it, and earlier defense delays the damage spike.

item_effects.name: Vengeful Shroud
item_effects.text: • Gain a Spell Shield that blocks the next Ability.

build_adaptations.when: Enemy shielding repeatedly prevents the physical ability conversion
build_adaptations.reason: Consider the current anti-shield item for the named shielding problem. Keep penetration and ability power scaling coherent; this is a flexible-slot answer, not an automatic response to any shield icon.

item_effects.name: Demonic
item_effects.text:
• Gain 20% Movement Speed for 2s.
• Deal 45% bonus magical damage.
• Does not exceed the size of the Shield.

corrections.before: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 25% Bonus Attack Speed) Projectiles, each dealing 8 (+1 per Level) True Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 30% Effectiveness (8s CD per Hero).
corrections.after: Damaging an Enemy Hero below 30% Health fires 4 (+1 per 30% Bonus Attack Speed) Projectiles, each dealing 8 (+1 per Level) True Damage and applying On-Hit effects at 30% Effectiveness (10s CD per Hero). Projectiles pass through walls and disappear after travelling 3000u. The effect correctly triggers on proc damage.
changes: Cooldown per Hero increased from 8s to 10s.

description_reviews.reason: The official notes change channel scaling from 30% to 40% magical power and 50% to 70% bonus physical power. This source expresses per-hit scaling instead. A hit-count conversion has not been established, so those per-hit values are not treated as current.
The notes give a 15.5–91.5% range and +4.5% per level. Those endpoints do not reconcile across 18 levels. The published range is retained, but no per-level table has been invented.
The official patch changes Bayle’s base physical power and its growth. The source basic-attack level table has not been reconciled with those changes.
Narbash’s official base physical power increases from 58 to 60. The source basic-attack level table still starts at 58; no replacement level table is inferred.

The official L.I.N.X damage values are 48/69/90/111/132. The source has separately parameterized outgoing, return, and pulse damage. Their exact mapping has not been verified, so the old components are shown only for inspection.

The source differs from the 1.16 release description in the third-rank base damage and the flat empowered-hit damage. The explicit 1.16.1 target-health change is corrected, but the other discrepancies remain unverified.
